hooks.statusMessage: 방금 고친 파일을 지키는 장치 확인
hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; for p in "$VIDEOBOX_GUARD_PYTHON" "$d/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$d/.venv/bin/python"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" "$d/scripts/guard_router.py" --hook post-tool-use; done; echo '{"systemMessage":"guard_router: no .venv python found - nothing was checked"}'

hooks.statusMessage: 이번에 바뀐 파일 전체를 지키는 장치 확인
hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; for p in "$VIDEOBOX_GUARD_PYTHON" "$d/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" "$d/.venv/bin/python"; do [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" "$d/scripts/guard_router.py" --hook stop; done; echo '{"systemMessage":"guard_router: no .venv python found - nothing was checked"}'
